title: Multiplexed scNOMe-seq Protocol Based on Isolated Single Nuclei
author: Sebastian Pott
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.btutnnwn
materials: To prepare CT Conversion Reagent add the following buffers to one bottle of CT Conversion Reagent: 7.9 mL M-Solubilization Buffer 3 mL M-Dilution Buffer Once the reagent is fully dissolved through shaking and vortexing vigorously, add: 1.6 mL M-Reaction Buffer
Denature the samples by placing the 384-well PCR plates on a thermocycler and run the following program: 95°C 3 minutes

Prior to denaturing the samples, make Adaptase Master Mix and keep sealed on ice: A B C 1 Reagent Volumes for 1 96-well plate (+10 extra reactions) (µL) Volumes for single reaction (µL) 2 Elution Buffer (Qiagen) 450.5 4.25 3 Buffer G1 212 2 4 Reagent G2 212 2 5 Reagent G3 132.5 1.25 6 Enzyme G4 53 0.5 7 Enzyme G5 53 0.5 8 Total 1113 10.5 Reaction volume: 20.5 µL
After FACS, heat plates to 50ºC for 20 minutes in a thermocycler to facilitate nuclei lysis. 50 °C, 20 minutes Store plates at -20ºC or move on to the next step.
Denature the samples by placing 96-well plates on a thermocycler and run the following program: 95°C 3 min

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare all necessary buffers and reagents before starting nuclei isolation.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 384- or 96-well collection plates with digestion mix (can be done 1 day prior, store at 4ºC).
Prepare Proteinase K by adding 1.04 mL of Proteinase K Storage Buffer to one tube of Proteinase K per Zymo Kit instructions.
Prepare 10X RSB buffer (100mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4, 100mM NaCl, 30mM MgCl2); store at 4ºC for up to one year.
Make a 1:10 dilution of 10X RSB buffer to create 1X RSB buffer (prepare at least 5 mL).

steps.title: Isolate Single Nuclei
steps.instruction: Isolate nuclei from a suspension of approximately 5-10 million single cells.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cells to a 15 mL Falcon tube and spin for 5 minutes at 500xg at 4°C.
Discard supernatant and wash once with ice-cold PBS; spin for 5 minutes at 500xg at 4°C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend cells in 1 mL ice-cold 1X RSB buffer.
Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Add 15 µL 1% NP-40 solution (0.015% final concentration) to the suspension.
Transfer suspension to a 2 mL dounce tissue grinder and burst cells with 15 strokes of the pestle.
Transfer lysed cells to a 1.5 mL eppendorf tube and centrifuge for 5 minutes at 800xg at 4°C.
Discard supernatant and wash with 1 mL 1X RSB buffer (without NP-40).
Incubate in RSB buffer for 30 seconds to 1 minute.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 800xg at 4°C.

steps.title: Perform GpC Methylation
steps.instruction: Methylate the isolated nuclei using GpC methyltransferase.

substeps.instruction: Discard supernatant and resuspend in 1X GpC methyltransferase buffer such that there are 1M cells per 75 µL (if <1M cells, use 75 µL).
Prepare a 1.5 mL eppendorf tube with GpC Methylase Reaction Mix: 7.5 µL GpC methyltransferase buffer (10X), 1.5 µL SAM (32mM), 50 µL GpC Methyltransferase (4U/µL), and 16 µL Distilled H2O.
Add 75 µL of nuclei to the mix (total volume 150 µL) and pipette to mix.
Incubate at 37ºC for 7.5 minutes.
Add a boost of 25 µL GpC Methyltransferase (100U) and 0.75 µL 32mM SAM.
Incubate at 37°C for another 7.5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclei for FACS Sorting
steps.instruction: Wash and stain the methylated nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL 1X PBS and spin for 5 minutes at 800g at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and resuspend in 0.5-1 mL 1X PBS.
Add 2 drops of Hoechst (use 1 drop if resuspension volume is <500 µL).
Keep on ice for ~15 minutes before FACS sorting.

steps.title: Bisulfite Conversion
steps.instruction: Convert cytosines to uracils using CT conversion reagent.

substeps.instruction: Add 15 µL CT conversion reagent to each well of two 384-well plates and pipette up and down 8 times to mix.
Seal plates with adhesive film and quick spin for 10 seconds at 2,000xg at room temperature.
Run the following thermocycler program: 98°C for 8 minutes, 64°C for 3.5 hours, then 4°C hold.

steps.title: Clean Up Bisulfite Conversion
steps.instruction: Purify DNA using Zymo-Spin 384-Well DNA Binding Plates.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Random Primer Solution for 8 primers at a final molarity of 500nM; keep on ice.
Load 80 µL M-Binding Buffer into each well of Zymo-Spin 384-Well DNA Binding Plates placed on 2.0 mL 96-Well Deep Well Plates.
Transfer bisulfite conversion reactions to the binding plates and pipette up and down 8 times to mix.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 5,000xg.
Decant flow-through and add 100 µL M-Wash Buffer to each well; centrifuge for 5 minutes at 5,000xg.
Decant flow-through and add 50 µL M-Desulphonation Buffer to each well; incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 5,000xg.
Decant flow-through and add 100 µL M-Wash Buffer to each well; centrifuge for 5 minutes at 5,000xg.
Repeat the M-Wash step once more.

steps.title: Random Priming and Synthesis
steps.instruction: Perform random priming to synthesize complementary strands.

substeps.instruction: Place DNA Binding Plates on two new 384-well PCR plates and add 7 µL Random Primer Solution to each well.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 5,000xg and discard the DNA Binding Plate.
Seal the 384-well PCR plate and store at -20°C for up to 1 week.
Prepare Random Priming Master Mix (1X Blue Buffer, 1.25U/µL Klenow exo, 500uM dNTPs, Distilled H2O) and keep on ice.
Place the plate on ice for 2 minutes.
Add 5 µL Random Priming Master Mix to each well.
Vortex and quick spin for 10 seconds at 2,000xg.
Run thermocycler program: 4°C 5 min, 25°C 5 min, 37°C 60 min, 4°C hold.

steps.title: Remove Unincorporated Primers
steps.instruction: Use Exonuclease I and rSAP to clean the reaction.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 µL Exo/rSAP Master Mix (1.74U/µL Exonuclease I and 0.043U/µL rSAP) to each well.
Vortex and quick spin for 10 seconds at 2,000xg.
Run thermocycler program: 37°C 30 min, 4°C hold.

steps.title: Prepare SPRI Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare a custom SPRI bead solution.

substeps.instruction: Mix Sera-Mag SpeedBeads and transfer 280 µL to a 1.5 mL tube.
Place on magnetic stand until clear, remove supernatant, wash twice with 1 mL TE, and resuspend in 280 µL TE.
In a 50 mL conical tube, combine 2.52 g PEG 8000, 2.8 mL 5M NaCl, 140 µL 1M Tris-HCl (pH 8.0), and 28 µL 0.5M EDTA (pH 8.0).
Add 7-8 mL distilled H2O and mix until PEG 8000 dissolves.
Add the washed Sera-Mag SpeedBeads and bring total volume to 14 mL with distilled H2O; vortex before use.

steps.title: Sample Pooling and First SPRI Cleanup
steps.instruction: Pool samples and perform the first bead-based purification.

substeps.instruction: Add 73.6 µL (0.8x) SPRI beads to each well of a clean 96-well PCR plate.
Pool samples from the two 384-well PCR plates into the 96-well plate (8 samples per well, indexed with different random primers).
Vortex and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Quick spin for 10 seconds at 2,000xg at room temperature.
Place on DynaMag TM-96 Side Magnet until clear (~5 minutes).
Wash beads 3 times with 150 µL fresh 80% EtOH.
Remove all EtOH and air dry beads at room temperature (do not overdry).
Remove from magnet, add 10 µL Elution Buffer (Qiagen), and resuspend by pipetting.
Vortex and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Quick spin for 10 seconds at 2,000xg at room temperature.
Place on magnet until clear (~5 minutes).
Transfer 10 µL of supernatant to a clean 96-well PCR plate (can be stored at -20ºC).

steps.title: PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the DNA using specific P5L and P7L primers.

substeps.instruction: Place the sample plate on ice for 2 minutes.
Run thermocycler program: 37°C 30 min, 95°C 2 min, 4°C hold.
Prepare a PCR Primer Mix plate: add 3 µL P5L primer (final 600nM) to columns and 3 µL P7L primer (final 1µM) to rows.
Transfer 5 µL of the appropriate primer mix to the sample plate wells.
Add 25 µL 2X KAPA HiFi Mix to each well.
Vortex and quick spin for 10 seconds at 2,000xg.
Run thermocycler program: 95°C 2 min; 98°C 30 sec; then 15 cycles of (98°C 15 sec, 64°C 30 sec, 72°C 2 min); 72°C 5 min; 4°C hold.
Add 40 µL (0.8x) SPRI Beads to each well of the 96-well PCR plate.
Vortex and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Quick spin for 10 seconds at 2,000xg at room temperature.
Place on DynaMag™-96 Side Magnet until clear (~5 minutes).
Remove supernatant and wash beads 2 times with 150 µL fresh 80% EtOH.
Remove all EtOH and air dry beads at room temperature.
Add 25 µL Elution Buffer (Qiagen) and resuspend by pipetting.
Vortex and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Quick spin for 10 seconds at 2,000xg at room temperature.
Place on magnet until clear (~5 minutes).

steps.title: Final Pooling and Purification
steps.instruction: Combine samples and perform final cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Combine 25 µL eluent from all wells in each column (8 wells per column) into 12 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.
Add 160 µL (0.8x) SPRI Beads to each tube, pipette to mix, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on DynaMag™-2 Magnet until clear (~5 minutes).
Remove supernatant and wash beads 2 times with 500 µL fresh 80% EtOH.
Remove all EtOH and air dry beads at room temperature.
Add 40 µL Elution Buffer (Qiagen), resuspend by pipet, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnet until clear (~5 minutes).
Transfer 40 µL supernatant to 12 new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.
Measure concentration using Qubit dsDNA BR Assay Kit.

steps.title: Adaptor Addition
steps.instruction: Add adaptors to the purified DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 10.5 µL Adaptase Master Mix to each well of the 96-well PCR plate.
Vortex and quick spin for 10 seconds at 2,000xg.
